Job Title: IT PeopleSoft Developer
 Location: Painted Post, NY 14870
 Duration: 1+ Year 
 Job Description: 
 Provides operational support for mission critical PeopleSoft Finance and Supply Chain Applications supporting a global organization.
 Participates in 24x7 on-call rotational support model
 Minimum 5 years of development and operational support experience in a PeopleSoft Financial and Supply Chain environment. Prefer PeopleTools 8.5x experience.
 Minimum 5 years’ experience with Oracle SQL or similar relational database.
 Strong knowledge of and adherence to development standards (including testing and migration procedures) and implementing best practices.
 Demonstrated experience with Oracle SQL performance tuning and optimization.
 Ability to demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills and lead high-visibility efforts.
 Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with end users.
 Strong conceptual and problem solving skills, with the ability to develop initiatives, as well as recommend solutions to improve efficiency.
 Need to be capable of working independently, as well as in a team environment.
 Strong expertise with PeopleTools (PeopleCode, Application Designer, Application Engine/Cobol/Sqr, BI Publisher, Data Mover, Integration Broker, etc.).
 BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.
 Excellent functional and technical understanding of PeopleSoft General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Cash Management (A/R) as well as a working knowledge of Billing, Inventory, Cost Accounting , Manufacturing (PIDs/BOMs/Routings), and EDI
 Experience with Control-M, ServiceNow and exposure to ITIL a plus.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Thanks & Regards,
 Abhinav Kandere
 732 844 8718
 Integrated Resources, Inc.
